There has been a lot of false teaching as to the devil, Satan, and I believe that God’s Word tells us what happened and when.  God made Lucifer, the anointed Cherub, and sent him to the Garden of Eden to minister to Adam and Eve (Ezekiel 28:13-19).  This shows that Lucifer had not fallen until he, through the serpent, caused Adam to sin in the Garden of Eden (Genesis 3:1-6).  By eating of the fruit of the tree of good and evil, man sinned against God, and made Lucifer become the devil, Satan, and made Satan the god of this world.  Satan retained his home in heaven (Job 1:6-12, and Revelations 12:10-12).  Satan then started talking some of the Angels in heaven into serving him instead of God.  This is where the demons came from, as they are the fallen angels.

When Jesus came to earth and died for us, and was resurrected, He then returned to heaven, and that is when Jesus and the Holy Angels made war with Satan and the fallen angels, and cast them onto the earth (Revelations 12:7-9).  At the time this happened, apparently Satan had about one-third of the angels that were cast out of heaven with him (Revelations 12:3-4, Jude 1:6).  The teachings that Satan existed before God made man, is not consistent with the bible at all.  I believe the Word of God teaches the above truth, and that means that God made Lucifer, and man made Satan by yielding to him, and sinning against God.  I pray that you will study those scriptures, and see these truths for yourself.  You can learn more by visiting our web page “New Revelations” on our web site.  Praise God for giving us His Word, and the Holy Spirit, so we can know these things!
